summary: Show Recycled Action Plan Test Record
description: Returns a Recycled Action Plan Test Record

id.description: Unique identifier of the test record.

plan_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the Action Plan Item this test record belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the test record was created. ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the test record was moved to the recycle bin. ISO 8601 format.

payload.description: Contains specific attributes depending on the type of Action Plan Test Record

checklist_id.description: Identifier of the linked checklist instance. Present when type is 'checklist'.

checklist_template_id.description: Identifier of the checklist template used. Present when type is 'checklist'.

form_id.description: Identifier of the linked form instance. Present when type is 'form'.

form_template_id.description: Identifier of the form template used. Present when type is 'form'.

generic_tool_id.description: Identifier of the linked generic tool. Present when type is 'generic_tool'.

generic_tool_item_id.description: Identifier of the linked generic tool item record. Present when type is 'generic_tool'.

meeting_id.description: Identifier of the linked meeting. Present when type is 'meeting'.

submittal_log_id.description: Identifier of the linked submittal log. Present when type is 'submittal_log'.

observation_item_id.description: Identifier of the linked observation item. Present when type is 'observation'.

viewer_url.description: URL to view the linked record in context. Present for attachment, photo, and form types.

plan_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan.

plan_test_record_request_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent test record request this record fulfills.

type.description: Categorization of the test record. Determines which payload fields are populated.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the test record was last modified. ISO 8601 format.
